bcr_rpo_site_loss_rows.statement: Ledger continuity is itself attested on a standing cadence, independent of any incident — proposed quarterly, DEFAULT-class, revisable on evidence. This is a routine health check, not a response to failure; its purpose is confirming the RTO would hold if tested, before it has to be.

Disaster scenarios beyond single-component failure — total site loss, where the appliance itself (Akki_Appliance_Assembly_Spec_RevA) is destroyed or inaccessible — are not addressed by S-10 or S-11, both of which assume the Ledger writer is recoverable in place. Given the appliance's own dedicated, per-site deployment model (trust_domains_v1 §1), a total site loss scenario has no ruled answer: whether there is an off-site backup, and if so its own RPO/RTO, is unaddressed.

A fine-tuned artefact MAY be pruned — magnitude pruning or an equivalent structural reduction — between MOAC acceptance and DAP-31's distance gate, as a ruled optional step. Pruning is a second, empirical reduction in memorisation surface on top of DAP-36's differentially private training; it is never a substitute for it, and this document does not present it as one. A pruned artefact MUST re-pass MOAC's acceptance criteria — pruning can degrade performance below the accepted bar, and acceptance is re-evaluated, not assumed to survive the change. A pruned artefact's hash differs from its pre-pruning hash; it is a new artefact for every purpose DAP-10 and DAP-31 govern, including a fresh pass through the distance gate at the ruled threshold. Pruning ratio and method are ruled values, ratified alongside DAP-31's own probe parameters.

Every registered artefact carries a capability-class register: the enumerated set of action and output classes it is admitted to exercise. The register is seeded at admission with the minimum its stated purpose requires (AC-2's narrow start), grows only through RBM-8's ceremony, and is versioned with the artefact — a new artefact hash inherits no admissions; its register is re-ratified with the version.

An objective is mandatory on every entry. An entry whose objective cannot be stated in one sentence is refused at ceremony — a string nobody can say the purpose of is a string nobody can say is still right.

Every record carries its source, its writing pipeline where known, and its write time where known. A record with none of the three is not failed; it is marked provenance-unknown, which caps its stratum at Suspect for any purpose requiring defensibility.
